agent_notes: Rampura is extremely hard to isolate: searches for 'Rampura'/'रामपुरा' + Bikaner overwhelmingly surface the unrelated Rampuria Havelis (a Bikaner city heritage site) and dozens of same-named villages elsewhere in India (Nagaur, Jalaun, Tonk, Sirohi, Neemuch, Jaipur, etc.), none of which are in Lunkaransar/Mahajan. The census2011.co.in mirror's list of all 125 Lunkaransar-tehsil villages does NOT include any 'Rampura' (closest names: Rambagh, Ramsara, Ranisar).
